mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses equity discount rates through reduced risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer spending momentum, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 105 (index 2017=100) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days during expansionary phases.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 105, or Rank IC for the condition falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained housing starts above 1100 thousand units reflect strong consumer confidence and spending, consistently producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without external triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1100, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price index exceeding 235.982 signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 235.982, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market contraction that precedes economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for interaction falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235.982) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) creates policy uncertainty that depresses equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 235.982 and FEDFUNDS < 0.2, or Rank IC for regime condition falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
